seo.title: Caltrac AI for Professionals FAQ: Cost, Review, Client Consent
seo.description: Answers on cost, review time, client consent and what dietitians, nutritionists and trainers can see in Caltrac AI for Professionals.
seo.h1: Questions about Caltrac AI for Professionals

items.question: Who can join?
items.answer: Dietitians, nutritionists and trainers. Only your name and email are required on the form. The other details help us review your application.

items.question: Does it cost anything?
items.answer: Joining and using Caltrac AI for Professionals is free.

items.question: How long does review take?
items.answer: A person at Caltrac AI reads every application. The review is manual, and you receive the outcome by email within 24–48 hours.

items.question: What happens after I'm approved?
items.answer: We create your professional account, email you the details and give you your linking code. Nothing is created before approval.

items.question: Who runs Caltrac AI?
items.answer: Caltrac AI is run by CALTRACAI CORP. You can reach us at [support@caltrac.ai](mailto:support@caltrac.ai).

items.question: What is Caltrac Connect?
items.answer: Caltrac Connect is an optional feature in the Caltrac AI app, opened from the button in the app's top bar. A client can connect with a nutritionist, dietitian or trainer, who can then view their meals and leave comments. The client controls access and can revoke it at any time.

items.question: What can I see about my clients?
Can I comment on meals?
items.answer: Yes. Your comment appears in the Caltrac AI app next to the meal it refers to.

items.question: How do my clients connect with me?
items.answer: Give them your linking code. They enter it in Caltrac Connect and send you a request; access starts when you accept it. Send them [How your clients connect](/how-your-clients-connect) for the steps.

items.question: Can I add or invite a client myself?
items.answer: No. Every link starts with the client.

items.question: How do clients log meals?
items.answer: With a photo or a short description. Caltrac AI estimates calories and macros, and clients can edit the foods and serving sizes before saving. They are estimates, not exact measurements.

items.question: Which phones does it need?
items.answer: Caltrac AI is available on the App Store and Google Play. On iPhone it needs iOS 17 or later, and on Android it needs Android 14 or later.

items.question: What does Caltrac AI for Professionals focus on?
Who controls access?
items.answer: The client. Access starts when you accept their request and ends when they stop sharing.

items.question: Can a client stop sharing?
items.answer: Yes, at any time. They don't need approval from you or from Caltrac AI, and it takes effect immediately.

items.question: What data does Caltrac AI collect, and who can see it?
items.answer: Caltrac AI's [Privacy Policy](/privacy) explains what we collect and who can see it.

items.question: I want to track my own meals. Where do I go?
items.answer: Use the Caltrac AI mobile app. This site is for professionals.
